kind: static snapshot — NOT a live or self-refreshing test
method: WebFetch of GIBS DescribeDomains (TILEMATRIXSET=GoogleMapsCompatible_Level9). The tool returns a model summary quoting the <Domain> text, not raw bytes; MODIS Terra was returned in three quoted segments joined here without changes. MODIS Terra Bands 7-2-1 was not quoted in full (size 10) and is therefore not included.
update_procedure: Manual only; no automated or verified update script exists. Re-request DescribeDomains for each layer, replace the domain strings and size values, change captured_on, and re-run the tests. Expected values in test/gibs-live-domains.test.js (latest dates, gap dates) must then be reviewed by hand.
